$comment: Source palettes for frontend-ui-modern themes. `palette` = official hex values (see `source`). `roles` map onto shadcn tokens via scripts/theme.mjs: bg surface surface2 border fg fgMuted primary primaryFg destructive chart1-5 [ring sidebar sidebarAccent sidebarBorder input popover success successFg warning warningFg info infoFg]. A role value is a palette name, a #hex, or name@alpha. `derived: true` marks variants with no official light/dark counterpart.

catppuccin.title: Catppuccin
catppuccin.vibe: soothing pastels; 4 flavors; the most popular theme of the 2020s dotfiles scene

dracula.title: Dracula
dracula.source: https://draculatheme.com/spec (Dracula Classic + Alucard Classic, incl. UI background tiers)
dracula.vibe: purple-black with neon accents; one of the most installed editor themes ever

nord.title: Nord
nord.vibe: arctic, bluish, calm; Polar Night / Snow Storm / Frost / Aurora

gruvbox.title: Gruvbox
gruvbox.vibe: retro groove, warm earthy contrast; medium-contrast backgrounds

tokyo-night.title: Tokyo Night
tokyo-night.vibe: deep navy nights with neon blues and purples; Night / Storm / Moon / Day

rose-pine.title: Rosé Pine
rose-pine.source: https://github.com/rose-pine/palette (palette.json, 2025) — dawn text #464261 is current; older CSS used #575279
rose-pine.vibe: all natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes; Main / Moon / Dawn

solarized.title: Solarized
solarized.vibe: the 2011 classic; precision CIELAB lightness, 16 colors, dark and light

one-dark.title: One Dark / One Light
one-dark.source: github.com/joshdick/onedark.vim (hex) + atom/one-dark-syntax & one-light-syntax (HSL → hex); sidebar = one-dark-ui level-3 (base darkened 3%)
one-dark.vibe: Atom's default; cool gray with soft syntax colors

everforest.title: Everforest
everforest.vibe: green-based, comfortable, low-glare; forest at dusk / morning

light.title: Everforest Light (medium) — ink primary, green ring/charts (accents too light for button text)

kanagawa.title: Kanagawa
kanagawa.vibe: Hokusai's Great Wave; ink blacks, muted indigo, carp yellow; Wave / Dragon / Lotus

github.title: GitHub (Primer)
github.vibe: GitHub's own UI colors; familiar to every developer

ayu.title: Ayu
ayu.source: https://github.com/ayu-theme/ayu-colors v8.0.1 (src/{dark,mirage,light}.ts — the palette existing ports use; v9 (2025-12) regenerates lightness ladders)
ayu.vibe: simple, bright, elegant; amber accent; Dark / Mirage / Light

monokai.title: Monokai
monokai.source: VS Code built-in Monokai (microsoft/vscode extensions/theme-monokai) corroborated with the original Monokai.tmTheme
monokai.vibe: the 2006 Sublime classic; olive-black with acid green, pink and orange

light.title: Monokai Light (derived: warm neutral + Monokai accents)

themes.title: Nord (Snow Storm / Polar Night)
themes.note: light variant derived from the official palette
